name: no-campaign-ran
about: A day with no campaign spending: no campaign rows, the month's spend so far, and the cohorts.

output.headline: No campaigns ran on 2026-11-03, so there was no spend, no impressions, no clicks, and no leads for the day.
points: The day was entirely dark: $0.00 spent, 0 impressions, 0 clicks, and no leads, with no cost per lead or click rate to report.
Month-to-date through 2026-11, with 28 days left, Meta has $400.00 in spend recorded — the only platform with activity so far this month.
The 2026-09-21 cohort brought in 38 leads: 33 contacted (86.8%), 17 converted (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 lost after conversion (21.1%).
The 2026-09-28 cohort brought in 40 leads: 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 converted (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost after conversion (22.5%).
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads so far — 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, 1 lost after conversion, and 0 hired — but it is too young to judge its rates.
Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded in the system for any cohort.
